tasks_completed.rationale: Spec 5.4: 'Auto-commit 不应该淹没 git log'. Both hooks now use git commit-tree + git update-ref to write only to refs/checkpoints/<current-branch>; HEAD never advances. Recovery procedure documented.

tasks_completed.description: M2 (5.1) — Strict-schema PreToolUse hook on Write|Edit
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec 5.1: block schema-violating writes at write-time. Hook reads tool_input, simulates post-edit content, invokes verify-plan-integrity.py --target-file ... --strict-schema --cross-ref --cross-ref-warn-only --agent-name <stem>; exit 2 on FAIL. Verifier extended with --target-file, --cross-ref, --cross-ref-warn-only, --agent-name flags. Wired in settings.json:102-118 AFTER pretool-block-production-files.sh (hook order preserved).

tasks_completed.description: M5 (5.6) — plan_label purged from data + schema
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec 5.6: 'plan_label 直接删除'. Migration script run under DEV_MIGRATION_BYPASS=spec-20260506-092951 (documented one-time bypass per spec §5.6 implementation note). 13 live plan_label hits in timeline.json + transportation.json removed; schemas/timeline.schema.json:77-80 plan_label property removed. The verifier's _check_forbidden_fields_one_file enforces the ban for future writes.

tasks_completed.description: M3 + M8 (5.3 + 5.9) — save.py --day mandatory + raw-write block + translation
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec 5.3: '批量操作永久禁止'. save.py --day N now mandatory (rejected --day < 1, missing --day, --batch behind BYPASS_DAY_GUARD). Spec 5.9: walk_translate maps user-language ('primary'/'plan_a'/'plan b'/'备选'/'主行程' etc.) onto schema's `optional` boolean; reject_banned refuses any input with plan_label/is_alternative/_isAlternative/tier/bundle_id/priority_label naming the unknown field. Hook pretool-validate-data-write.py blocks raw Write/Edit by data agents.

tasks_completed.description: M4 (5.5) — eight residual data bug fixes via migrate_spec_20260506.py
tasks_completed.rationale: Each of the eight bugs enumerated in spec §1 was addressed by a small idempotent function in migrate_spec_20260506.py. See evidence section for per-bug counts. AC6.1 (喜樂院子 in timeline+transportation) AC6.3 (Day 9 Xi'an + Chengdu->Xi'an HSR location_change) AC6.4 (budget arithmetic) AC6.5 (degenerate durations) AC6.8 (Weidu Beijing->Chengdu) all directly mutated. AC6.2/AC6.6/AC6.7 are no-op because the relevant strings either had already been corrected by prior cycles or matched no replacement criteria; documented in spec Section 3.

tasks_completed.description: M6 (5.7) — Cross-file referential integrity linter wired into M2 hook
tasks_completed.rationale: Spec 5.7: orphan POIs / hollow plan branches / triple-duplicate transit. Pure-python module imported by verifier on --cross-ref. Hook calls with --cross-ref-warn-only so pre-existing orphans don't block unrelated edits, but the linter still surfaces findings AND blocks writes that introduce NEW violations.

Spec 5.2: helper-path startup assert (FileNotFoundError on missing); broad except blocks at :408-411 and :433-436 narrowed to subprocess.TimeoutExpired + json.JSONDecodeError + OSError that record self._fetch_failures (unexpected exceptions propagate); _fetch_attempts/_fetch_successes counters; main() exits via _print_spec_5_2_banner which prints '✅ Cache hit: no fetches required' (attempts==0), '❌ Batch FAILED' (rate < threshold), '⚠️  Batch partial' (some failures), or '✅ Batch complete' (full success). Threshold via IMAGE_FETCH_SUCCESS_THRESHOLD env.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Multiple — schema plan_label leak source not bisected (out of scope); auto-commit hooks present since 2026-04-04; broad excepts in fetch-images-batch.py legacy
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Harness had zero write-time schema enforcement on data/**/*.json (PreToolUse only path-block; PostToolUse only checkpoint hook; deploy-time strict validator runs only at generate-and-deploy.sh). Combined with: save.py exposing --batch lacking --day; auto-commit hooks calling git commit (HEAD-advance) + git push; broad excepts swallowing all errors; schemas/timeline.schema.json leaking plan_label.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Structural enforcement at write-time (PreToolUse Write|Edit hook) + structural impossibility at API level (save.py --day mandatory) + side-ref auto-checkpoints (refs/checkpoints/<branch>) + narrow exception classes + plan_label removed from schema + cross-file referential-integrity linter + user-language translation layer in save.py.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Spec 5.1+5.2+5.3+5.4+5.5+5.6+5.7+5.9 each requires distinct code paths; 8 binding ACs cannot be met with <400 lines of new code. The hooks alone (~250 lines) plus migration script (~350 lines for 10 idempotent functions) are unavoidable. The fix is forward-only structural enforcement, not a localized patch.
